comments.body:
EPFL is a great place to study. OP will feel very differently once they make friends. 

That said: there are waaaay too many architecture graduates at the moment. The people I know from EPFL struggle because the classes are too large for Profs to have time, the pressure is high... And then you get paid crap money doing not-so-interesting buildings for years. In the hope of becoming a bit more self-sufficient. 

Do it if it's truly your passion, but checkout at EPFL "Communication Systems" (lots of math and IT) that will pay you a shit-ton of money, of "Life Sciences" which is full of fascinating topics on macroscale behaviors, robots, animals, biology. 

"Microtechnics" doesn't sound sexy but the industry is in dire need of people who can program small electronics. (Dire, as in they'll run after you, they even struggle to find expats). 

And these fields can lead to robotics and drones, which is an industry of the future, and pretty cool :)
comments.author: RealisticBookWoman
